name: Eamon Whitlock
source_profile:
Earl Eamon Whitlock, House Whitlock 
A wealthy northern noble whose family retained close commercial relationships with southern 
Cador, Eamon opposed secession on both political and economic grounds. He supported the 
royal armies throughout the conflict, using his considerable wealth to equip and provision 
loyalist forces. His appointment to Galrothe has made him prosperous and powerful, but he 
governs a deeply divided earldom. 
The Earldom of Dunmere 
River trade, mills, and agricultural prosperity.
